description: Financial infrastructure platform for processing online payments, managing billing, and handling global financial operations via API.
auth_notes: Uses API keys (secret or restricted) via HTTP Basic Auth (username as key) or Bearer token header.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free account instantly and generate test-mode or restricted API keys at no cost.
api_notes: Comprehensive resource-oriented REST API covering payments, subscriptions, invoices, customers, connect, issuing, and webhooks.
mcp_notes: Stripe provides developer tools and model context protocol/agent plugins for AI integration under developer resources.
rationale: Stripe has a fully documented broad REST API, free self-serve test credentials, and explicit agent/AI extension support.
